description: Open-source alternative to ElevenLabs, HeyGen & Rask AI. Clone a voice, dub your video into another language and post it to YouTube Shorts, TikTok or Reels. Runs locally on your computer.
readme:
PersoDub

Natural dubbing from the best open models.

Download · Hear the difference · How to use it · FAQ · Report a problem

Drop in a video. Clone the voice. Dub it. Fix any line. Post it to Shorts, TikTok or Reels.
Open-source, in each speaker's own voice, on your own computer: the ElevenLabs, HeyGen and Rask AI alternative you run yourself.

--- ## What it does
### Dub One video in, one dubbed video out, in each speaker's own voice. 10 languages on your computer, 100+ with the Perso API. ### Erase burned-in subtitles Box the subtitles, press **Erase**, and dub the clean video.
### Separate audio Split a video into the voice and the background. Export either one, or dub from there. ### Fix every line Edit a line by hand, or tell the **Dub Agent** "make line 2 fit". Only that line is remade.
## Hear the difference Same clip, English → Korean, each tool cloning the speaker's voice. The third video plays VideoLingo, KrillinAI, Voice-Pro and VoiceStudio one after another, each named at the top.
Original (English) PersoDub (Ours) Other tools
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/39589651-83fe-4673-91b4-fa078f0e523e https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c5b3e0a6-de2a-4026-bdcd-9b3c0f8d179a https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d6da4598-1f27-4eeb-8f23-5988a6582daa
Listen for pacing: PersoDub fits the translation to the time instead of speeding the voice up, and plays a line faster (10% at most) only when it would run into the next one. The source files live in [docs/demo](docs/demo): [VideoLingo](https://github.com/Huanshere/VideoLingo), [KrillinAI](https://github.com/krillinai/KrillinAI), [Voice-Pro](https://github.com/abus-aikorea/voice-pro), [VoiceStudio](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio). ## Get started 1. Download for [macOS](https://github.com/stronghamjji/PersoDub/releases/latest/download/PersoDub-mac.dmg) or [Windows](https://github.com/stronghamjji/PersoDub/releases/latest/download/PersoDub-Setup.exe). 2. Drop in a video, or paste a link. 3. Pick a language and press **Start dubbing**. **Updating from 0.8.4 or earlier?** Download and install the latest version once. From 0.8.5 on, PersoDub updates itself. Start dubbing uses this computer by default and needs no key. Speech-to-text still uses Perso while a Perso key is saved, and on a new install translation uses ChatGPT through your own sign-in. To keep everything on your computer, open **Advanced options** and set **Speech-to-text** to **Whisper** and **Translation** to **Hunyuan** or **Gemma 3**. To dub with the Perso API instead, save a free [Perso API key](docs/configuration.md) and set **Dubbing** to **Perso API**. First setup is under 1 GB. A Perso API dub downloads nothing more. The first dub on this computer downloads Python + PyTorch and the models: about 10 GB on a Mac, 17 GB on a Windows PC with an NVIDIA GPU, 9 GB without one. A local translator adds 1.6 to 10 GB and the subtitle eraser 4.4 to 9.3 GB, so keep 30 GB free, 40 GB on Windows with an NVIDIA GPU. [Full table](docs/requirements.md)
Install notes **macOS** — Open the `.dmg` and drag **PersoDub** into Applications. It is signed and notarized, so it opens with a normal double-click, and it checks for updates on launch. **Windows** — Run the `.exe`. It installs for your user account only. It is not code-signed yet, so SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC" the first time: click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. [Details](INSTALL.md#windows). A screen-by-screen walkthrough is in [docs/usage.md](docs/usage.md).
### Install with your AI assistant Paste this into Claude Code, Codex or any coding agent. ```text Install PersoDub on this computer and check that it works. Repository: https://github.com/stronghamjji/PersoDub 1. Check my OS, CPU, memory, free disk and GPU. PersoDub needs an Apple Silicon Mac or 64-bit Windows 10/11 and 30 GB of free disk (40 GB on Windows with an NVIDIA GPU); 16 GB of memory is recommended, and dubbing on this computer needs at least 8 GB. If this computer falls short, say so and stop. 2. Install the latest release for my OS: https://github.com/stronghamjji/PersoDub/releases/latest On Windows, SmartScreen warns (not code-signed yet): More info, then Run anyway. 3. Open PersoDub and wait for the first setup (under 1 GB). 4. Start dubbing uses this computer by default and needs no key. Ask me if I want a free Perso API key, for better transcription or the Perso API. If yes, open https://perso.ai/dubbing?utm_source=desktop_app_github&utm_medium=desktop-app&utm_campaign=desktop_app&utm_content=install_prompt then open PersoDub's Settings so I can paste the key in myself. Never ask to see it. For a Perso API dub, set Advanced options > Dubbing to Perso API. 5. Dub one video under a minute with me. Before a first dub on this computer, tell me the download size (9-17 GB). If I pick ChatGPT for translation, I sign in myself. A free account is enough. 6. Report the version, where projects are saved, and how to reopen the app. Finish the setup, not just a plan. Tell me any step you could not do. ``` ## Why PersoDub - **Your footage can stay yours.** PersoDub dubs on this computer by default. With Whisper and a local translator, none of it leaves. The Perso API, if you choose it, uploads the video. - **Fix any line after the dub.** Change the words, the speaker or the voice of one line and only that line is remade. Cut on the timeline, or tell the Dub Agent what to fix. - **Fits the words to the time.** Other tools speed the audio up. On this computer, PersoDub fits the translation instead, and speeds a line up (10% at most) only when it would run into the next one. - **Voice cloning, not narration.** Each speaker still sounds like themselves. - **Everything else is kept.** Music and effects stay. The translated `.srt` comes with the video, or burn it in from the Captions tab. ## Details | | | |---|---| | **Requirements** | Apple Silicon Mac or 64-bit Windows · 16 GB memory recommended · 30 GB free disk, 40 GB on Windows with an NVIDIA GPU.
